name: Field message
summary: The error, hint or automated message under a field, for fields Doras doesn't draw. Doras's own fields draw theirs.

when: Under a custom field, linked with aria-describedby.

whenNot.text: Under a Doras field: set its error instead.

anatomy.description: For errors and automated messages. Decorative.
The words, with a hidden “Error:” before errors.

values.description: What's wrong, and how to fix it.

states.name: Error
states.description: Error colour and icon, with “Error:” for screen readers.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Read as the field's description, with “Error:” before an error.

related.relationship: Lists the errors at the top of the page.

guidelines: Errors say how to fix them: “Enter your email address”.

dosAndDonts.do: Link it to its field with aria-describedby.
dosAndDonts.dont: Leave it floating under the field.

evidence.point: Messages tied to their field are read when the field is focused.
